coordinateSpace: anchor and focalRect are normalized fractions of the complete 256-by-256 source canvas; amplitude translation is measured at the 128-pixel review size
phaseConvention: Stable per-word phase in [0,1), baked into the rendered cycle. Authored clips retain their original frame timing.
reducedMotion: Use the reviewed still teaching pose and do not animate highlights or geometry.

authored_clip.intent: Play the reviewed joint-based teaching action, then its authored recovery.
authored_clip.deformation: Use the existing Blender atlas; never add a second whole-picture transform.

animal_breathe.intent: A small attentive breath and settled posture make the living animal feel present.
animal_breathe.deformation: Keep contact with the ground; move the upper body gently while feet and shell edges stay stable. Do not invent a walking cycle.

aquatic_glide.intent: A slow horizontal glide and slight buoyant rise suggest movement through water.
aquatic_glide.deformation: Preserve the creature silhouette; use translation and a tiny bank, without bending a photographed background.

airborne_hover.intent: A light lift, hover and return suggest flight or suspension in air.
airborne_hover.deformation: Translate and bank the acquired subject without stretching wings, strings or rigid airframes.

plant_sway.intent: A gentle breeze moves leaves and flexible growth from their attachment point.
plant_sway.deformation: Keep the lower stem or branch attachment fixed; taper motion toward that anchor.

vehicle_roll.intent: A restrained forward roll, gentle suspension settle and return show a moving vehicle.
vehicle_roll.deformation: Keep chassis and wheels rigid; use horizontal translation, not breathing or rubber-like scale.

buoyant_rock.intent: A boat settles through a small water-supported rocking cycle.
buoyant_rock.deformation: Rigid hull translation and slight rotation around the waterline, with no hull bending.

celestial_drift.intent: Slow drift and soft light variation give the space subject a sense of scale.
celestial_drift.deformation: Preserve astronomical structure and colors; do not spin a galaxy or star into an inaccurate shape.

weather_flow.intent: A soft directional flow suggests cloud, precipitation or moving air.
weather_flow.deformation: Confine the flow to the weather marks; keep explanatory symbols and landscape anchors steady.

water_ripple.intent: Moving highlights or a small liquid ripple animate the pictured water.
water_ripple.deformation: Keep vessels, shoreline, arrows and rigid shells fixed. Only the indicated liquid or water-light region moves.

flame_flicker.intent: A brief warm flicker draws attention to the visible flame or molten region.
flame_flicker.deformation: Animate local light and flame detail; do not warp the fireplace, mountain or surrounding structure.

elastic_bounce.intent: A short compress, lift and cushioned settle suit the depicted elastic object.
elastic_bounce.deformation: Only soft or inflatable subjects may squash; retain the ground contact and avoid an endless high jump.

supported_spin.intent: A small rotational motion acts around the object's actual central axis.
supported_spin.deformation: Rotate the selected rotor or disc as a rigid object; its support remains fixed.

human_gesture.intent: The already illustrated human gesture receives a small, natural anticipation and settle.
human_gesture.deformation: Use the specified upper-body or limb region; keep ground contact and any prop fixed. Never generate a new limb pose from a flat diagram.

face_expression.intent: A tiny attentive settle and local facial emphasis preserve the depicted emotion.
face_expression.deformation: Preserve the authored expression, including sadness, fear and anger; do not add a smile or infer hidden eye frames.

fabric_sway.intent: A small soft sway gives cloth a light flexible feel.
fabric_sway.deformation: Fix the attachment edge and confine movement to cloth; fasteners and structural supports remain rigid.

instrument_resonance.intent: A brief localized light pulse emphasizes the instrument while preserving its shape.
instrument_resonance.deformation: Keep the instrument body, keys and mouthpiece rigid; use bounded light/contrast emphasis rather than elastic wobble.

diagram_focus.intent: Travelling local light and contrast emphasis directs attention to a stable teaching diagram.
diagram_focus.deformation: Do not move comparison targets, pointers, numerals, body parts or relationship positions; preserve geometry and hue.

rigid_glint.intent: A soft travelling highlight reveals the stationary subject's surface and volume.
rigid_glint.deformation: Preserve all rigid geometry, supports, text and silhouette; animate only a restrained local light/contrast sweep.

scene_depth.intent: A restrained optical drift and soft depth light make a real scene feel alive.
scene_depth.deformation: Preserve the complete photograph or multi-object scene. Do not pretend a flat photograph contains separated limbs or independent objects.
